speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing hand tremors and recent memory issues; to begin my assessment, have you noticed if these tremors occur at rest or only when you are trying to perform a task like writing? Additionally, how would you describe the progression of your memory problems over the past few months?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Tremor with early cognitive decline due to age. However, the asymmetric onset of tremor and significant memory issues (paying bills) suggest a differential diagnosis of Parkinson's disease or frontotemporal dementia. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain.
